How to get it :
- [[Ore Acidizer|Ore Acidizer]] : ore (thorium), 500 mB sulfuric acid.
- [[Ore Acidizer|Ore Acidizer]] : raw ore (thorium), 333 mB sulfuric acid.

Used to make :
[[Thorium-232|Thorium Powder]], [[Uranium|Uranium Powder]], [[Radium-226|Radium-226 Nugget]], [[Thorium-232|Thorium-232 Ingot]].
